name: xvault
description: Local-first X/Twitter archive and media manager (Chrome and Edge MV3 extension; experimental Firefox build).

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run format:check
scripts.e2e:helper: node tests/helper-files-browser.mjs playwright "$CHROMIUM_PATH" && node tests/auto-backup-browser.mjs playwright "$CHROMIUM_PATH"
scripts.e2e:remote: node tests/remote-aurora-browser.mjs playwright "$CHROMIUM_PATH" && node tests/remote-product-browser.mjs playwright "$CHROMIUM_PATH" && node tests/remote-shell-browser.mjs playwright "$CHROMIUM_PATH" && node tests/remote-editor-browser.mjs playwright "$CHROMIUM_PATH" && node tests/remote-connection-browser.mjs playwright "$CHROMIUM_PATH" && node tests/remote-capture-browser.mjs playwright "$CHROMIUM_PATH"
